| If the pump size is...   | Then...                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| XLT-i                    | 1. Align the end plate on the pump side to the bearing housing so that you meet these conditions: a. The large slots on the end plate do not touch the bearing housing tap bolts. b. The small slots align with the impeller adjusting bolts. 2. Fasten the end plate to the bearing housing using the jam nuts on the impeller adjusting bolts. 3. Check the impeller clearance. Refer to the impeller clearance table for the correct impeller clearance. |

blocks.content: Put the pump-half of the coupling guard in place:
Place the coupling guard half  over the pump-side end plate.
